headline: Amendment to the State Grant-In-Aid Budget for 2027, updated Code of Conduct, and August 2026 budget reports.
summary: The agenda includes a vote to amend the State Grant-In-Aid Budget for 2027 and a vote to approve an updated Code of Conduct. It also covers August 2026 budget reports and incident reports for July and August.
items: Vote to approve the Director's Report
Vote to approve Budget Reports for August 2026
Incident Reports for July and August
Vote to amend the State Grant-In-Aid Budget for 2027
Vote to approve updated Code of Conduct
location: Woolley Conference Room, Pawtucket Public Library, 13 Summer Street, Pawtucket, Rhode Island 02860
